newsitem.title: CHINA: Cambodian sailors missing in Yangtze ship crash.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian sailors missing in Yangtze ship crash.

text.p: Three Cambodian sailors were missing after their 10,000-tonne ship sank in a collision with a Chinese ship at the mouth of China's Yangtze River, Shanghai's Xinmin Evening News said.

The cause of the incident, which happened in waters near Shanghai where the Yangtze meets the East China Sea on Friday morning, was still under investigation, the newspaper's late Saturday edition said.
The Cambodian ship, the Kangsong, sank quickly after the crash with the Chinese-registered Rose Sea, the newspaper said, adding that 38 of the 41-member crew aboard the Kangsong were rescued.
The Kangsong was shipping steel to Shanghai, it said, while Rose Sea was on its way to the eastern Chinese city of Nanjing carrying more than 28,000 tonnes of minerals from India.
Rose Sea belonged to a Qingdao shipping company and was not seriously damaged in the crash, it said.
